description: Your 2ndBrain: guard (protects raw/, author: me notes, .obsidian/) and schema validator for vault pages.

hooks.command: for py in python3 python 'py -3'; do if $py -c '' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec $py "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py"; fi; done; echo '[your-2ndbrain guard] no Python 3 found; guard inactive' >&2; exit 1

for py in python3 python 'py -3'; do if $py -c '' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec $py "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/validate.py"; fi; done; echo '[your-2ndbrain validator] no Python 3 found; validator inactive' >&2; exit 1
